3967-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
3967-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.
3967-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

3490-7075-7763-8201.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-7075-7763-8201.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-6559.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

2557-4365-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

270-1978-5793-7008.description:
Activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Hedron Archive which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

876-1253-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Gyre Engineer.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Gyre Engineer.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Gyre Engineer.
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Gyre Engineer.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Gyre Engineer.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Gyre Engineer from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2811-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1017-1494-5437-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

338-3330-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3330-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2292-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

413-891-4775.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

465-2921-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

969-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2203-2366-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

967-997-3809-4772-7087.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2558-6797-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

222-527-5686-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4067-6606-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6606-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Hoofprints of the Stag triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5147-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1920-2060-2313-4222-5328.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-2313-4222-5328.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

2226-2397-3570.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2226-2397-3570.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
2226-2397-3570.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Emancipation Angel by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Emancipation Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.

4017-4968.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Sunbond attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.
4017-4968.description:
Give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink, if needed.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2380-2534-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
2380-2534-4875.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

7-1631-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with +1/+1 counters on them.
7-1631-4050-5220.description:
Cast Battalion Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Battalion Foot Soldier, adding {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Battalion Foot Soldier from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Batallion Foot Soldier trigger from step 2, causing you to search your library for Batallion Foot Soldier and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

628-2034-2239-2596-3944.notablePrerequisites: Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-2239-2596-3944.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist and Mikaeus, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards in their graveyards, sacrifice all creatures they control, then put all cards exiled this way onto the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2743-3280-4285.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {3}{R}{R}, copying Croaking Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Croaking Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary that are 1/1 Frogs.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1984-2660-3454-4406.manaNeeded: {R}{W} the first turn, with {6}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
1984-2660-3454-4406.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon enchanting you.
Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
1984-2660-3454-4406.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Chance for Glory and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chance for Glory, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Chance for Glory into your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn and shuffle Angel's Grace into your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
At the beginning of your end step, Chance for Glory triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

1649-2068-3255-4404.easyPrerequisites: Goblin Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
1649-2068-3255-4404.description:
Activate Commander's Sphere's first ability by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Commander's Sphere's second ability by sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Goblin Engineer by paying {R}, tapping and sacrificing Corridor Monitor, targeting Commander's Sphere.
Ashnod triggers, copying Goblin Engineer's ability, targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the first Goblin Engineer ability, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Goblin Engineer.
Resolve the second Goblin Engineer ability, returning Commander Sphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat until you choose to stop or until you have no cards remaining in your library.
If desired, you may then repeat this loop but perform steps 3 through 7 in response to the Commander Sphere card draw ability, allowing you to repeat this loop infinite times. You must then win the game at instant speed or find another way to survive drawing from an empty library.

251-1681-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Twilight Shepherd does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
251-1681-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd, adding {C}{C}.
Twilight Shepherd dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Twilight Shepherd enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting a +1/+1 counter on Twilight Shepherd.
Repeat.

2034-2698-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-2698-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Vogar's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2816-3430-4137.notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Blossoms.Weaver of Blossoms does not have summoning sickness.
2816-3430-4137.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {6}.
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by paying {3} and untapping itself, getting +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

351-2428-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
351-2428-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to draw a card and deal 1 damage to target player.
When you draw a card, Horizon Chimera will trigger, gaining you 1 life.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.

1457-2499-2766-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four additional mana-producing lands.
1457-2499-2766-3821.description:
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Molderhulk.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Endless Sands and up to four other lands.
Activate your other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Endless Sands and up to four other lands.
Activate your other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Endless Sands's last ability by tapping it, paying {4}, and sacrificing it, returning Peregrine Drake and Molderhulk from exile to the battlefield.
When Molderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice.
When Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, it triggers itself twice.
Resolve the first Molderhulk trigger, returning Endless Sands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Molderhulk trigger, returning up to one target land of your choice from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Molderhulk.
Repeat from step 4.
